target_claim: For every well-ordered set S, the lexicographic order on the set T of all finite tuples over S is not a well-ordering.
source_quote:
=== [[Infinite Lexicographic Order on Well-Ordered Sets is not Well-Ordering|Proof for Infinite Product]] ===
Consider a set $S = \set {a, b}$ such that $a \prec b$.

Then the set $\set {\tuple b, \tuple {a, b}, \tuple {a, a, b}, \tuple {a, a, a, b}, \ldots}$ has no [[Definition:Minimal Element|minimal element]] by $\preccurlyeq_l$.

Thus $T$ is not [[Definition:Well-Ordering|well-ordered]] by $\preccurlyeq_l$.
